specifications.name: Logic levels
specifications.text: Standard volt HC series levels. Logic 1: 3.SV min 20 ma source Logic 0: 1V max 20 ma sink.

specifications.name: Circuit protection
specifications.text: 1.5 amp circuit breaker, current Limiting regulators and overvoltage protecting zener diode.

specifications.name: Discrete control inputs
specifications.text: Opto-isolators maybe strapped for or 12 to 24 volt operation. 10 ma nominal control current

specifications.name: Discrete control outputs
specifications.text: Dry relay contacts 24V dc at 50 ma max
